correctness.rationale: Each F-LLoM component has the exact Lomax survival \(S_m(y|x)=(1+y/\kappa_m(x))^{-\lambda_m}\). Its survival and density have explicit power equivalents with constants \(\kappa_m^{\lambda_m}\) and \(\lambda_m\kappa_m^{\lambda_m}\). A finite positive-weight sum is therefore dominated exactly by the minimum shape. Bayes division by the mixture survival proves survivor-tier localization, and the unique-minimum rate follows by comparing the Lomax \(O(y^{-1})\) correction with the smallest exponent gap. The checker independently evaluates exact finite formulas.

value.rationale: Latent risk tiers and extreme-event interpretation are explicit motivations of F-LLoM. The finding shows that the tier interpretation becomes asymptotically decisive: a unique heaviest-tail tier captures essentially all sufficiently extreme survivors, while ties have explicit limiting posterior weights. The simultaneous hazard cancellation shows which part of covariate heterogeneity survives at first order and which does not. This is a structural consequence for model interpretation, not a routine numerical refinement.
